title: Join Redwire at LANDEURO 2026
summary: The inaugural LANDEURO 2025 welcomed more than 2,200 attendees from 45 nations, featuring 80 exhibitors representing eight countries and demonstrating the collective commitment of allies and partners…
body_markdown:
The inaugural LANDEURO 2025 welcomed more than 2,200 attendees from 45 nations, featuring 80 exhibitors representing eight countries and demonstrating the collective commitment of allies and partners to strengthening security and operational readiness across Europe.


At this year’s event, Redwire will showcase robust multi-domain capabilities designed to provide military forces with the operational advantage needed in today’s contested environments. Visitors to **booth N-442** will have the opportunity to learn more about Redwire’s[Stalker and Penguin Uncrewed Aircraft Systems (UAS),](https://rdw.com/product-archive/uncrewed-systems/)[Octopus EO/IR payload solutions,](https://rdw.com/product-archive/octopus-isr-and-optics-payloads/) and[propane-powered fuel cells](https://rdw.com/product-archive/energy-systems/) that are supporting defense customers across Europe and around the world.


As one of the largest advanced defense technology manufacturers in the Baltics with more than[300 aircraft delivered to Ukraine](https://rdw.com/newsroom/combat-proven-innovation-redwires-penguin-uas-supports-ukraine-as-a-trusted-multi-mission-asset/) , Redwire has built a strong track record of supporting NATO allies and partner nations with reliable, battle-tested capabilities. Through its production facility in Riga, Latvia, and extensive experience supporting defense and security missions throughout the region, Redwire is trusted by military customers worldwide and continues to deliver innovative solutions that enhance situational awareness, border security, force protection, and mission impact.


**Discover how Redwire is providing the modern warfighter with combat proven capabilities by visiting booth N-442 at LANDEURO 2026.**
